title: Fluorescent solvatochromism and nonfluorescence processes of charge-transfer-type molecules with a 4-nitrophenyl moiety
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,46297-46307
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07359F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Marino Miwa, Akitaka Ito
A novel naphthalene derivative with 4-nitrophenyl and methoxy groups exhibited significant fluorescent solvatochromism, and the nonfluorescence processes of the derivatives with a 4-nitrophenyl group was elucidated.
